page.overview:
Who is Saiyan beyond God?

This state first appears in Dragon Ball Z: Resurrection ‘F’, a pamphlet for the movie explained its nature.

The Saiyan beyond God state displays no real differences from the user's base form. As such, the user may only appear with the standard white aura their base form normally displays.

The Saiyan beyond God state appears to be a result of the Super Saiyan God's Crimson Radiance being retained in base form and further trained to be harnessed by the user naturally. Thus, Goku first unintentionally became a Saiyan beyond God in Dragon Ball Z: Battle of Gods, and then deliberately trained to master the new state in Dragon Ball Z: Resurrection ‘F’, which in turn caused the God's Crimson Radiance to evolve his Super Saiyan form into Super Saiyan Blue. Thus, Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan appears to be the Super Saiyan counterpart to Saiyan beyond God, as a Saiyan beyond God attempting to transform into a Super Saiyan will enter this state instead.

In the anime, while training inside Whis’s Staff, it is noted by Vegeta that to retain this state, the Saiyan must raise their energy while also controlling it so it does not leak out - it is noted by Goku that initially it is very demanding to keep all the energy inside, with Vegeta realizing that this is the secret to divine energy, calling it intense, and thus, like the Super Saiyan Blue form, this state requires absolute ki control to maintain it. In the Dragon Ball Super anime, the Saiyan beyond God state does not possess godly ki, but it raises the user's energy to the same power level of Super Saiyan God and allows the user to sense godly ki.
